beats.care: Lakhs of Indians work at sea, often on tankers. Shipping trouble here also pushes up oil and fertiliser costs, which feed into prices at home.
beats.what: A projectile hit the tanker MT ST 3 in the Strait of Hormuz on 16 October. All 15 Indian crew are safe, the minister said.
beats.why: Iran says it is stepping up strikes after a US blockade of its ports. Two ships sank near the strait this week.

cards.note: Petro Dolphin's two missing sailors were still being searched for in the last official update.
cards.title: Indian crew on tankers hit near the Gulf since 9 Oct

cards.body: A UN plan would let about five fertiliser ships a day through Hormuz, coordinated from Oman. It could start within 7 to 10 days, but only if the US and Iran both agree. A UN official warned farmers could miss the planting season.
Not right now. India began the rabi season with 17 million tonnes in stock, 38% more than last year. But it imports most of the gas used to make urea, so a long blockade still hurts.
